La firma es correcta, pero parte del con: The signature is correct, but part of the document's content is not signed.
No se ha podido comprobar todo lo que cu: It was not possible to check everything the signature covers, so it is not treated as valid.
La firma es válida, aunque no cubre algu: The signature is valid, although it does not cover some of the document's metadata because its format leaves them out. The details list which ones.
El documento no ha cambiado desde que se: The document has not changed since it was signed, but the signature uses SHA-1, an old algorithm that is no longer considered secure. For that reason it is not treated as valid: it serves as evidence of a signature made when SHA-1 was accepted.
La firma coincide con la forma de prepar: The signature matches the way earlier versions of GrxFirma prepared the XML, not the standard way. It was most likely made by one of those versions. It is not treated as valid.
Con esa forma antigua no quedaban firmad: That old method did not sign processing instructions outside the root element, such as a style sheet, and this document has some. They may have been added after signing.
El documento declara una DTD externa que: The document declares an external DTD that GrxFirma does not read. If that DTD adds values to the document, what another program shows may not be what was signed, so the signature is not treated as valid.
Compatibilidad histórica; validación XML: Historical compatibility; standard XML validation not established.
revocación no concluyente: Certificate revocation could not be checked. The signature is not considered valid.
no se pudo consultar un almacén raíz del: The system root certificate store could not be read, so it is not known whether the certificate is trusted. The signature is not considered valid.
clave RSA del firmante de menos de 2048: The signer’s key is RSA with fewer than 2048 bits, a size no longer considered secure. The signature is not considered valid.
el certificado firmante no está destinad: The certificate used to sign is not meant for signing documents (it may be, for example, a web server certificate). The signature is not considered valid.
verify.forced_trust.hint: If you trust this signature, you can accept it in the settings on this computer.
verify.forced_trust.forbidden: This computer's policy does not allow accepting these signatures manually. If you need them, contact whoever manages the computer.
verify.forced_trust.error.unknown_type: That case does not exist. Use ca_desconocida, clave_rsa_corta, certificado_componente, revocacion_no_comprobable or algoritmo_sha1.
verify.forced_trust.error.fingerprint: The fingerprint must be the certificate's SHA-256, in hexadecimal (64 characters).
verify.forced_trust.error.global_type: This case is accepted for all signatures and takes no fingerprint.
cadena verificada hasta una raíz del alm: The certificate chains to a trusted root of the system. This does not guarantee that it is a qualified certificate.
la firma no indica entre sus datos firma: The signed data does not say which certificate was used, so it cannot be checked that the certificate shown is the one that signed.
el PDF contiene firmas que no se han pod: The PDF has signatures that GrxFirma cannot verify, so it cannot be considered valid.
el PDF contiene un sello de tiempo de do: The PDF has a document timestamp that has not been checked.

el PDF se modificó después de la firma:: The PDF was modified after signing: what is shown is not what was signed

certificado vigente en fechas; revocació: Certificate within its validity period; revocation not checked
no se pudo completar la comprobación de: The revocation check could not be completed
cadena válida, ningún certificado revoca: Valid chain; no certificate is revoked
no se pudo confirmar que los certificado: It could not be confirmed that the certificates are not revoked
no se pudo comprobar la revocación del c: The certificate's revocation status could not be checked
revocación embebida evaluada: Revocation data included in the signature has been evaluated
evidencia de revocación embebida pendien: The revocation data included in the signature has not yet been authenticated
evidencias embebidas pendientes de verif: The evidence included in the signature is pending verification

cadena válida con revocación embebida no: Valid chain; the revocation data in the signature is inconclusive

sin certificado firmante embebido: The signature does not include the signer's certificate
sin certificado firmante para evaluar co: There is no signer certificate with which to evaluate trust
sin anclas de confianza disponibles: No trusted root certificates are available
ninguna ancla de confianza configurada c: None of the configured trusted root certificates contains verifiable X.509 data

sin respuesta concluyente del servicio d: The revocation service did not give a conclusive answer

verifactu.title: Check Veri*Factu records
verifactu.scope: Checks Veri*Factu records produced by your invoicing software. GrxFirma does not create, store or send them to the AEAT: your invoicing software sends them. To sign a record, use “Sign” with the “Veri*Factu record” format.
verifactu.limit: The size or complexity limit has been exceeded.
verifactu.xml: The XML is invalid. DTDs and external entities are not allowed.
verifactu.structure: The record has a missing, extra or badly written field. Ask your invoicing software to generate it again. The report has the details.
verifactu.value: The record has a missing, extra or badly written field. Ask your invoicing software to generate it again. The report has the details.
verifactu.key: An RSA key with a valid certificate suitable for signing is required.
verifactu.duplicate: Records in the chain have the same hash.
verifactu.previous_missing: The previous record is outside the selection. This chain link cannot be checked.
verifactu.signature_sha1: The record has not changed since it was signed, but the signature uses SHA-1, an old algorithm that is no longer considered secure and is not the one the AEAT requires. Sign it again with the “Veri*Factu record” format.
verifactu.signature_sha1_acceptable: The record has not changed since it was signed, but the signature uses SHA-1, an old algorithm that is no longer considered secure and is not the one the AEAT requires. Sign it again with the “Veri*Factu record” format. If you trust this signature, you can accept SHA-1 on this computer: verify the record in Verify and press “Accept on this computer”, or use the command -aceptar-confianza -tipo-confianza algoritmo_sha1.
verifactu.certificate: The certificate was not valid on the record date.
verifactu.qr_url_label: Paste the QR URL or enter it with a scanner
verifactu.qr_notice: Reading the address, image or PDF sends no data. “Check with the AEAT” sends only the tax ID, number, date and amount from the QR code.

verifactu.qr_params: The QR code has missing or extra data. It must contain the issuer’s tax ID, the invoice number, date and amount.
verifactu.qr_service: The AEAT query timed out or returned an invalid response.
verifactu.output: Save the report to a file other than the input record.
verifactu.empty_state: Choose an XML record or a folder of records to check them.
verifactu.qr_query_help: Asks the AEAT whether it has an invoice registered with these details.
verifactu.qr_aeat_found: The AEAT has an invoice registered with these details.
verifactu.qr_aeat_not_found: The AEAT has no invoice registered with these details, or it has been cancelled. Check the tax ID, number, date and amount.
verifactu.qr_aeat_unknown: The AEAT replied, but GrxFirma does not recognise the result. Review the technical response or check the invoice on the AEAT website.
verifactu.qr_reading: Looking for the QR in the file…
verifactu.qr_pdf: The PDF could not be converted to an image to look for the QR. Try a PNG or JPEG screenshot of the invoice.
verifactu.cli_qr_input: leer-qr-verifactu and cotejar-qr-verifactu accept in -entrada the QR URL or a PNG, JPEG or PDF file.
firma.sha1_corresponde.prohibido: The signature uses SHA-1 and this computer's policy does not allow that algorithm, so the operation was not carried out. If you need to use this old signature, ask whoever manages this computer.
verifactu.qr_aeat_not_verifiable: The AEAT cannot check this invoice against its records. The issuer may not have sent it or may not use Veri*Factu.
verifactu.qr_aeat_rejected: The AEAT could not run the check with the details in this QR. The technical response shows the reason the AEAT gives.
verifactu.qr_empty: Paste the QR URL or choose an image.
firma.cofirma_sin_original.pedir_origina: This signature does not contain the signed document. To co-sign or countersign it, also choose the original document with "Add the original document" so you can see what you are signing.

If your organization does not allow it, contact your administrator.

excepciones.afp_aad_ambigua.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: open an AFP v1 file with ambiguous metadata. An .afp file stores protected content and metadata such as its name.

excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_crear.tit: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_crear.rie: The private key remains outside the system secret store. For example, another program with access to your account could copy the private key file.
excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_crear.ace: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that a private key stored outside the secure store can be copied by another program with access to my account. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.

excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_crear.ayu:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: create a strong protection key in a file without secure storage. A strong-protection identity needs a private key normally held in the system secret store.
Why it is unsafe: The private key remains outside the system secret store. For example, another program with access to your account could copy the private key file.
When it may make sense: Only on a controlled device without a secret store.
Alternative: Enable the system secret store before creating the identity.
What changes: enabling “Create strong protection keys in a file” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Create strong protection keys in a file” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_leer.titu: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_leer.ries: The private key is outside the system secret store. For example, a program with access to the file could copy the old key while it is in use.
excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_leer.acep: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that an old private key stored outside the secure store can be copied by another program with access to my account. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_leer.orga: Your organization does not allow “Use strong protection keys stored in a file” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.alto_clave_fichero_leer.ayud:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: use an old strong protection key stored in a file. The strong-protection identity uses a private key previously stored in a file.
Why it is unsafe: The private key is outside the system secret store. For example, a program with access to the file could copy the old key while it is in use.
When it may make sense: Only to recover documents protected with that old identity.
Alternative: Enable the secret store so GrxFirma can migrate the key when possible.
What changes: enabling “Use strong protection keys stored in a file” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Use strong protection keys stored in a file” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.

excepciones.ca_clave_fichero.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.ca_clave_fichero.riesgo: Anyone who can read the file can use the local CA key. For example, a program in your account that copies the key could create false local certificates.
excepciones.ca_clave_fichero.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that the local authority key stored outside the secure store can be copied. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.ca_clave_fichero.organizacio: Your organization does not allow “Store the local CA key in a file” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.ca_clave_fichero.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: store the local CA private key in a file without secure storage. The local authority creates the certificate GrxFirma uses for its local connections.
Why it is unsafe: Anyone who can read the file can use the local CA key. For example, a program in your account that copies the key could create false local certificates.

Alternative: Enable the system secret store to hold the local authority key.
What changes: enabling “Store the local CA key in a file” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Store the local CA key in a file” in Preferences, Security.

excepciones.ca_instalacion_automatica.ti: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.ca_instalacion_automatica.ri: Installation extends browser trust. For example, the browser will trust the local authority for certificates it can issue.
excepciones.ca_instalacion_automatica.ac: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that installing the local authority extends browser trust. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.ca_instalacion_automatica.or: Your organization does not allow “Install the local CA automatically” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.ca_instalacion_automatica.ay:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: install the local CA automatically when opening a signing link on Linux. The local authority issues certificates for the connection between GrxFirma and the browser.
Why it is unsafe: Installation extends browser trust. For example, the browser will trust the local authority for certificates it can issue.

Alternative: Install the authority explicitly using the installer or GrxFirma command.
What changes: enabling “Install the local CA automatically” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.

excepciones.cms_aes_ecb.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.cms_aes_ecb.riesgo: AES-ECB reveals patterns in the content. For example, identical parts of the document leave identical patterns in the encrypted data.
excepciones.cms_aes_ecb.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that AES-ECB reveals patterns in encrypted content. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.cms_aes_ecb.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Read AutoFirma 1.9 AES-ECB CMS” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.cms_aes_ecb.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: open an AutoFirma 1.9 AES-ECB CMS envelope. CMS is an encrypted-file format. AES-ECB encrypts equal blocks in a way that leaves visible patterns.
Why it is unsafe: AES-ECB reveals patterns in the content. For example, identical parts of the document leave identical patterns in the encrypted data.
When it may make sense: Only to recover old AutoFirma 1.9 envelopes.
Alternative: Request a copy protected by current encryption that hides patterns and checks for changes.
What changes: enabling “Read AutoFirma 1.9 AES-ECB CMS” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Read AutoFirma 1.9 AES-ECB CMS” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.cms_cbc.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.cms_cbc.riesgo: AES-CBC does not authenticate the content and may hide changes. For example, a change to the encrypted file may go undetected when it is opened.
excepciones.cms_cbc.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that AES-CBC does not authenticate the content and may hide changes. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.cms_cbc.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Read CMS with AES-CBC” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.cms_cbc.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: open a CMS envelope encrypted with AES-CBC. CMS is an encrypted-file format. AES-CBC is an encryption mode that does not by itself check whether content was changed.
Why it is unsafe: AES-CBC does not authenticate the content and may hide changes. For example, a change to the encrypted file may go undetected when it is opened.
When it may make sense: Only to recover an old envelope whose source you know.
Alternative: Request a copy encrypted with a mode that also checks integrity, such as AES-GCM.
What changes: enabling “Read CMS with AES-CBC” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Read CMS with AES-CBC” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.cms_cifrado_heredado.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.cms_cifrado_heredado.riesgo: These ciphers no longer protect the content adequately. For example, an old file may use DES and disclose more information to someone who obtains it.
excepciones.cms_cifrado_heredado.aceptac: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that DES, 3DES and other old ciphers no longer protect the content adequately. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.cms_cifrado_heredado.organiz: Your organization does not allow “Read CMS with legacy ciphers” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.cms_cifrado_heredado.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: open a CMS envelope encrypted with DES, 3DES or another legacy cipher. CMS is an encrypted-file format for one or more recipients.
Why it is unsafe: These ciphers no longer protect the content adequately. For example, an old file may use DES and disclose more information to someone who obtains it.
When it may make sense: Only when you need to recover an old file from a known source.
Alternative: Ask the sender to encrypt the document again using a current format and a new key.
What changes: enabling “Read CMS with legacy ciphers” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Read CMS with legacy ciphers” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_crear.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_crear.riesgo: This key transport is older and less resilient than RSA-OAEP with SHA-256. For example, an older program processing the envelope may reveal information about the key through its responses.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_crear.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 uses an old key transport that is less resilient than RSA-OAEP. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_crear.organizaci: Your organization does not allow “Create CMS with legacy RSA key transport” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_crear.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: create a CMS envelope with RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport. CMS is an encrypted-file format. RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 is an older way to encrypt the content key.
Why it is unsafe: This key transport is older and less resilient than RSA-OAEP with SHA-256. For example, an older program processing the envelope may reveal information about the key through its responses.
When it may make sense: Only if the recipient cannot open the current key transport.
Alternative: Use RSA-OAEP with SHA-256, which GrxFirma selects by default.
What changes: enabling “Create CMS with legacy RSA key transport” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Create CMS with legacy RSA key transport” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_leer.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_leer.riesgo: This key transport is older and less resilient than RSA-OAEP with SHA-256. For example, an envelope made for older programs may expose information about the key when different responses are tested.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_leer.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 uses an old key transport that is less resilient than RSA-OAEP. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_leer.organizacio: Your organization does not allow “Read CMS with legacy RSA key transport” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.cms_rsa_v15_leer.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: open a CMS envelope with RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport. CMS is an encrypted-file format. RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 is an older way to encrypt the content key.
Why it is unsafe: This key transport is older and less resilient than RSA-OAEP with SHA-256. For example, an envelope made for older programs may expose information about the key when different responses are tested.
When it may make sense: Only to recover envelopes from a known sender.
Alternative: Ask the sender for a new envelope using RSA-OAEP and SHA-256.
What changes: enabling “Read CMS with legacy RSA key transport” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Read CMS with legacy RSA key transport” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.cofirma_sin_original.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.cofirma_sin_original.riesgo: The previous signature cannot be checked against that document. For example, you could sign a digest without seeing the document signed by other people.
excepciones.cofirma_sin_original.aceptac: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that without the original document, the previous signature cannot be checked against it. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.cofirma_sin_original.organiz: Your organization does not allow “Co-sign or countersign without the original” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.cofirma_sin_original.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: co-sign or countersign without the original document. A co-signature adds a signature to an existing one; a countersignature signs a previous signature.
Why it is unsafe: The previous signature cannot be checked against that document. For example, you could sign a digest without seeing the document signed by other people.
When it may make sense: Only if you cannot obtain the original and understand the scope of the signature.
Alternative: Supply the original document so GrxFirma can check it against the previous signature.
What changes: enabling “Co-sign or countersign without the original” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Co-sign or countersign without the original” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.des_intercambio.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.des_intercambio.riesgo: DES and the short exchange key are insecure even over HTTPS. For example, the short package key may be recovered even when the server uses HTTPS.
excepciones.des_intercambio.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that DES and the short exchange key are unsafe even over HTTPS. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.

excepciones.des_intercambio.ayuda:

Why it is unsafe: DES and the short exchange key are insecure even over HTTPS. For example, the short package key may be recovered even when the server uses HTTPS.

What changes: enabling “Use DES in AutoFirma 1.x exchanges” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Use DES in AutoFirma 1.x exchanges” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.llamante_desarrollo.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.llamante_desarrollo.riesgo: More callers can request native host operations. For example, a test extension could request native host operations.

excepciones.origen_vacio.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.origen_vacio.riesgo: The initiating website cannot be identified. For example, a request without an origin does not identify which page opened the connection.

excepciones.origen_vacio.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Accept WebSocket without an origin” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.origen_vacio.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: accept a WebSocket connection without an identified origin. The origin of a WebSocket connection identifies the page that opened it.

What changes: enabling “Accept WebSocket without an origin” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Accept WebSocket without an origin” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.pdf_cifrado_heredado.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.pdf_cifrado_heredado.riesgo: RC4 and AES-CBC with MD5 derivation retain weak protection. For example, a new revision would still use RC4 or a key derived using MD5.
excepciones.pdf_cifrado_heredado.aceptac: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that a new signature can retain RC4 or AES-CBC with MD5 derivation from the original PDF. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.pdf_cifrado_heredado.organiz: Your organization does not allow “Sign PDFs with legacy encryption” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.

Alternative: Request a copy protected with current encryption before signing.
What changes: enabling “Sign PDFs with legacy encryption” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Sign PDFs with legacy encryption” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.pkcs11_experimental.titulo: The app blocks this for your security

Alternative: Use a certificate from the system store or a supported driver.
What changes: enabling “Use experimental PKCS#11 drivers” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Use experimental PKCS#11 drivers” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.proxy_http.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.proxy_http.riesgo: HTTP does not protect credentials on the connection to the proxy. For example, another device on the network can capture the proxy username and password.
excepciones.proxy_http.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that HTTP does not protect credentials sent to the proxy. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.proxy_http.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Send credentials to an HTTP proxy” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.proxy_http.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: send proxy credentials over HTTP. A proxy is an intermediary network server. HTTP does not encrypt the connection to it.
Why it is unsafe: HTTP does not protect credentials on the connection to the proxy. For example, another device on the network can capture the proxy username and password.
When it may make sense: Only on a managed network where the required proxy does not support protected transport.
Alternative: Use an HTTPS proxy or one that does not request credentials over HTTP.
What changes: enabling “Send credentials to an HTTP proxy” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Send credentials to an HTTP proxy” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.rsa_corta.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.rsa_corta.riesgo: That key length no longer meets the required minimum security level. For example, a 1024-bit key provides less resistance than the 2048-bit minimum.
excepciones.rsa_corta.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that an RSA key shorter than 2048 bits no longer meets the required minimum security level. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.rsa_corta.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Sign with RSA keys under 2048 bits” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.rsa_corta.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: sign with an RSA key shorter than 2048 bits. RSA is the public-key algorithm used for signing.
Why it is unsafe: That key length no longer meets the required minimum security level. For example, a 1024-bit key provides less resistance than the 2048-bit minimum.
When it may make sense: Only for an old process that accepts no other identity and whose risk you have accepted.
Alternative: Use a certificate with an RSA key of at least 2048 bits.
What changes: enabling “Sign with RSA keys under 2048 bits” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Sign with RSA keys under 2048 bits” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.rutas_directas.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.rutas_directas.riesgo: The website can choose a local destination instead of the user. For example, a website could suggest a path other than the one you would have chosen.
excepciones.rutas_directas.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that a website will be able to supply an absolute local path instead of letting me choose it. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.rutas_directas.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Accept local paths requested by a website” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.rutas_directas.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: use an absolute local path supplied by a website. An absolute path identifies a specific file or folder on the device.
Why it is unsafe: The website can read or replace local files without letting you choose each one. It could expose access keys or change files that affect how other programs start.
When it may make sense: Only for an authorized portal whose workflow requires a fixed path.
Alternative: Choose the file or folder yourself in the GrxFirma dialog.
What changes: enabling “Accept local paths requested by a website” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Accept local paths requested by a website” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.sha1_conservar.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.sha1_conservar.riesgo: SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. For example, the resulting document would retain a signature whose digest no longer offers current protection.
excepciones.sha1_conservar.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that an old SHA-1 signature, vulnerable to collisions, will remain in the new document. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.sha1_conservar.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Keep SHA-1 signatures in ENI or co-signatures” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.sha1_conservar.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: keep an old SHA-1 signature in an ENI document or co-signature. SHA-1 is an older algorithm that calculates the signature digest.
Why it is unsafe: SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. For example, the resulting document would retain a signature whose digest no longer offers current protection.
When it may make sense: Only if you must retain a historical signature that matches the original.
Alternative: Request a new signature using SHA-256 or better and supply the original document.
What changes: enabling “Keep SHA-1 signatures in ENI or co-signatures” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Keep SHA-1 signatures in ENI or co-signatures” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.sha1_crear.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.sha1_crear.riesgo: SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. For example, two different documents can be made to share the same digest under this algorithm.
excepciones.sha1_crear.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.sha1_crear.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Create SHA-1 signatures” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.sha1_crear.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: create a SHA-1 signature. SHA-1 is an algorithm that calculates the digest used by the signature.
Why it is unsafe: SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. For example, two different documents can be made to share the same digest under this algorithm.
When it may make sense: Only if an old website requires SHA-1 and rejects a current signature.
Alternative: Ask the website operator to accept SHA-256 or better.
What changes: enabling “Create SHA-1 signatures” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Create SHA-1 signatures” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.sha1_leer.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.sha1_leer.riesgo: SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. For example, an old signature may have a digest that does not provide the protection expected today.
excepciones.sha1_leer.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.sha1_leer.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Evaluate old SHA-1 signatures” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.sha1_leer.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: evaluate an old SHA-1 signature. SHA-1 is an older algorithm that calculates the signature digest.
Why it is unsafe: SHA-1 no longer provides sufficient collision resistance. For example, an old signature may have a digest that does not provide the protection expected today.
When it may make sense: Only to examine a historical signature while understanding its limits.
Alternative: Request a new signature using SHA-256 or better if you need a current signature.
What changes: enabling “Evaluate old SHA-1 signatures” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Evaluate old SHA-1 signatures” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.trifasica_http.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.trifasica_http.riesgo: HTTP does not protect the exchange with the server. For example, someone on the network could see or alter data exchanged with the signing server.
excepciones.trifasica_http.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that HTTP does not protect data exchanged with the signing server. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.trifasica_http.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Use three-phase signing over HTTP” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.trifasica_http.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: carry out three-phase signing over HTTP. Three-phase signing exchanges data with a server in several steps. HTTP does not encrypt that connection.
Why it is unsafe: HTTP does not protect the exchange with the server. For example, someone on the network could see or alter data exchanged with the signing server.
When it may make sense: Only if the authorized portal requires HTTP and offers no HTTPS address.
Alternative: Ask the portal for an HTTPS address for multi-stage signing.
What changes: enabling “Use three-phase signing over HTTP” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Use three-phase signing over HTTP” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.tsa_http.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.tsa_http.riesgo: HTTP does not protect the connection to the timestamp authority. For example, someone on the network can observe or alter the request sent to the timestamp service.
excepciones.tsa_http.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that HTTP does not protect the request sent to the timestamp service. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.tsa_http.organizacion: Your organization does not allow “Contact a timestamp authority over HTTP” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.tsa_http.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: send the document digest to a timestamp authority over HTTP. A TSA is a timestamp authority. HTTP is a network connection that does not encrypt traffic.
Why it is unsafe: HTTP does not protect the connection to the timestamp authority. For example, someone on the network can observe or alter the request sent to the timestamp service.
When it may make sense: Only if the organization requires an HTTP address with no secure alternative.
Alternative: Configure the HTTPS address of the timestamp service.
What changes: enabling “Contact a timestamp authority over HTTP” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Contact a timestamp authority over HTTP” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
excepciones.xml_c14n_antigua.titulo: The app blocks this for your security
excepciones.xml_c14n_antigua.riesgo: Its interpretation may differ from the current standard. For example, two programs may reconstruct the exact signed text differently.
excepciones.xml_c14n_antigua.aceptacion: I can enable this at my own risk. I understand that the old way of interpreting XML can differ from the current standard. I can turn it off again in Preferences, Security.
excepciones.xml_c14n_antigua.organizacio: Your organization does not allow “Evaluate XML with historical canonicalization” on this device. Your user setting cannot override that decision. Contact the device administrator.
excepciones.xml_c14n_antigua.ayuda:
What happened: GrxFirma stopped this operation: evaluate an XML signature with historical or undeclared canonicalization. XML is a document format. Canonicalization defines the exact bytes checked by its signature.
Why it is unsafe: Its interpretation may differ from the current standard. For example, two programs may reconstruct the exact signed text differently.
When it may make sense: Only to inspect a historical XML signature from a known source.
Alternative: Request a new XML signature that declares a current normalization method.
What changes: enabling “Evaluate XML with historical canonicalization” allows this operation. Every use will show a warning in the result.
How to undo it: turn off “Evaluate XML with historical canonicalization” in Preferences, Security.
Organization block: if your organization forbids it, you cannot enable it. Contact the administrator.
